SELECT
	InvCode = SL.SaleInvCode,
	Vehicle = MAX(SL.Vehicle),
	ICode = SD.ICode, 
	AliasName = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	PackQty = SUM(SD.PackQtyForSale),
	DiscPerc = SD.DiscPerc,
	Qty = SUM(SD.LooseQty),
	BonusQty = SUM(SD.BonusQty),
	Rate = SD.SalePrice,
	Discount = SUM( 
		(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) + 
		(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + 
		(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (SL.DiscPerc * 0.01))),
	SalesTax = SUM( ((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax) + 
		(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (SD.GSTPerc * 0.01))),
	MiscCharges = SL.MiscCharges,
	FlatDisc = SL.FlatDisc
FROM
	SaleLedger SL, 
	SaleDetail SD,
	Item I
WHERE
	:as_type = 'SV' AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = :ai_invcode AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY
	SL.SaleInvCode,
	SL.MiscCharges,
	SL.FlatDisc,
	SD.ICode,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	SD.SalePrice,
	SD.DiscPerc
UNION ALL
